name: Broken Wing
description: The Broken Wing was a starship piloted by the bounty hunter Beilert Valance during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Valance utilized the Broken Wing when he was hired by the Hidden Hand criminal syndicate to lead a team on a hunt for the Imperial enforcer Darth Vader. The vessel was shot down during a skirmish with Vader, but was retrieved and repaired by the Empire, who ordered Valance to work for them. After leading Imperial forces to the base of the Hidden Hand, Valance escaped in the Broken Wing, returning to work as a bounty hunter.
